run_grammar_constrained_generation: run the generate script with a model id, grammar file, and prefix prompt to produce grammar-constrained text
build_incremental_grammar_constraint: build an IncrementalGrammarConstraint from a grammar file string, root symbol, and tokenizer for constrained decoding
create_grammar_logits_processor: create a GrammarConstrainedLogitsProcessor from an IncrementalGrammarConstraint to enforce grammar rules during generation
generate_constrained_text: generate text using model.generate with a GrammarConstrainedLogitsProcessor to ensure output follows a grammar
review_main_function: review the main function that loads a model, applies grammar constraints, and generates constrained text output
